cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(TerraWebKitToolchainProbe LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(TERRA_EXPECT_MOCHIOS)
    if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "mochiOS" OR NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Expected a real mochiOS cross toolchain; host fallback is forbidden")
    endif()
    if(NOT CMAKE_SYSROOT OR NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SYSROOT}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "mochiOS requires a real CMAKE_SYSROOT")
    endif()
    if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|amd64|AMD64)$")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "The mochiOS engine currently targets x86-64")
    endif()
    add_compile_definitions(TERRA_EXPECT_MOCHIOS=1)
    foreach(mode LIBRARY INCLUDE PACKAGE)
        if(NOT CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_${mode} STREQUAL "ONLY")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Cross toolchain must isolate ${mode} searches with ONLY")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    if(NOT CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM STREQUAL "NEVER")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Build tools must execute on the host")
    endif()
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Terra currently requires a 64-bit target")
endif()
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
# Both final link operations must succeed, even if try_compile uses static archives.
add_library(terra_probe_shared SHARED shared.cpp)
target_link_libraries(terra_probe_shared PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
add_executable(terra_probe main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(terra_probe PRIVATE terra_probe_shared Threads::Threads)
